items.text: Abeemilisi babandu basanjila Yesu

Olunyuma lwetsindaalo tsibili lialilisabo liaPasaka nende eliOmukaate okubulamwo Amamela; abakhulundu babakuhani nende abahandiichi bali nibakhaabanga shinga olwa nabamuhambe mubuchesichesi nibamwira;
okhuba basunga bari Khuleshe okhukhola mundaalo tsielisabo; indiri yakheekhola mubandu.
Yesu yabashilwa amafura eBetsania

Nolwa yali nali eBetsania munzu yaSimoni owobuchele, olwa yali niyeekhaale naliitsanga, omukhasi undi niyeetsa nali nende ichupa yamafura keshing'aari akobukusi obutinyu; niyaara ichupa, nakatsukha khumurwekwe.
Ne bali nibalimwo abandu bandi abasinyikha abeene nabeene, bari Amafura kano kasasiibwe butswa kario mbushi?
Shichila amafura kano kakhakusiibwe amapeesa akashila tsitinari ebikhumi bitaru, natsio nitsikabilwa abamanani. Nibamubuutsuluulila.
Naye Yesu naboola mbu Muleshe abe; mumunyasinjia mbushi? Yakholeele omulimo omulayi.
Okhuba abamanam mubeetsanga ninabo tsindaalo tsiosi; ne buli olwa mwenyanga lwosi munyala okhubakholela amalayi; ne isie shimuli ninasi tsindaalo tsiosi ta.
Akholile aka anyala; yeekholeeleele okhunzushiilila omubii kwanje amafura khulwa okhuyabilwa.
Ne emusunjila toto, mbu Buli aha Amakhuwa Amalayi kaleelwatsungwa mushialo shiosi, akeenako aka omukhasi uno akholile nako kalarumbulungwa, kabe eshiitsuliloshie.
Yuda yafuchiilila okhukhoba Yesu
Ne Yuda Isikariote oyo, owali mulala khwIkhumi-nababili abo, yarula natsia ewabakhulundu babakuhani, mbu amukhobe mumakhono kabwe.
Nabo, olwa bahulilakhwo, basangaala nibamulaka okhumuheelesia amapeesa. Naye nakhaaba obwiyangu okhumuhaana mumakhono kabwe.
Yesu yalia Pasaka halala nabeechibe
Mana khunyanga yambeli yemikaate echibulamwo amamela, eya bali nibamalilangakhwo Pasaka, abeechibe nibamureeba bari Hali heena aha wenya khutsie khukasie aha noliile Pasaka?
Naye naruma babili abokhubeechibe, nababiila mbu Mutsie mwitookho, ne mulabukaana nende omusaatsa owituushile isiongo yamatsi; mumulondekhwo;
ne hosi aha nayeenjile, musunjile omusaatsa omwenengo muri Omwechesia areeba mbu Shili heena eshisika shianje shiobucheni omwa nendiile Pasaka halala nende abeechi banje?
Naye omwene alamumanyia eshisika eshikali eshiahekulu, eshialilwe nishirecheekhwe; mubwenomwo mukhukasilie.
Abeechi abo nibarula, niboola khwitookho, nibanyoola bario shinga olwa yali nabasunjiile; nibakasia Pasaka.
Nolwa bwoola mungoloobe, niyeetsa halala nende abo Ekhumi-nababili.
Nolwa bali nibeekhale nibaliitsanga, Yesu yaboola mbu Emuboolela toto, mbu mulala khwinywe, ouliitsanga ninasi halala, yeetsa okhukhoba.
Nibachaaka okhubeelela, nibamureeba mulala mulala, bari Nisie noho?
Nabasunjila ari Nimulala khubano Ekhumi-nababili, owa khutonjela ninaye halala mulukaye.
Okhuba Omwana wOmundu yeenyokha, shinga olwa kamuhandiichilwa; ne woowe khumundu oyo oumukhoba Omwana wOmundu! Omundu oyo alabula okhwibulwa ta, khane bwakhabeele obulayi khuye.
Okhusimikha khwelisabo liOmwami
Nolwa bali nibaliitsanga yabukula omukaate, ne namalile okhukusabila ikhabi, yakusonyola, nabaheelesia, nasunga ari, Bukule; kuno nomubili kwanje.
Nabukula eshikombe, ne namalile okhushiupila mbu orio, yabaheelesia; bosi nibanywakhwo.
Nabasunjila mbu Kano namabanga kanje akeIndakano, akeebeenela abandu abanji.
Emuboolela toto mbu shindalanywakhwo khandi khubiamo biemitsabibu ta, okhuula khunyanga yilia olwa ndalanywakhwo obuyia mubwami bwaNyasaye.
Nolwa bali nibamalile okhwimba olwimbo barula nibatsia ebunashikulu shiEmitseituni.
Yesu yaboola khale aka Petero okhumwambakhana
Yesu nababoolela ari Inywe mwesi namwisichirasibwe; shichila kahandiikwa mbu Ndalamukhupa omwayi, nako amakondi kalasalaana.
Nebutswa, olwa ndakhabe nimalile okhulamusibwa, ndakhamuranjilile okhutsia eGalilaya.
Naye Petero namusunjila mbu Kata bosi nibaba nibeesichirasibwa, ne isie ta.
Yesu namusunjila ari Ekhuboolela toto mbu iwe, eshilo shiolwa leelo, itaywa niyirashialakula khabili ta, olandiyambakhana khataru.
Naye nameeta okhuboola butinyu muno, ari Kata nimba nikhoyile okhufwa ninawe, shinekhwiyambakhanekhwo ta Khandi bosi nihahoola bario.
Yesu yasaayila eGetsesemane
Niboola habundu ahalangwa mbu Getsesemane; nasunjila abeechibe ari Mwikhale hano, nishisaaya.
Natsia nende Petero naYakobo naYohana, nachaaka okhurambilwa elala, nasitohelwa okhushila mumwoyo.
Nabasunjila ari Omwoyo kwanje kuli neshibeela eshinji; shienya okhunzira; mulinde hano, ne mube meeso.
Natsiakhwo imbeli hatiiti, niyeekhupa hasi, nasaaya mbu, nikaba nikanyalikha, eshise eshio shimubirekhwo.
Naboola mbu Aba, Papa, amakhuwa kosi kanyalikhanga khwiwe; umbiniekhwo eshikombe shino; nebutswa karaba aka enzenya isie ta, habula aka iwe wenya.
Niyeetsa, nabanyoola nibali mundoolo, nasunjila Petero ari Simoni, okona? Shionyalile okhuba meeso isaa ndala ta?
Mube meeso, nimusaaya, mbu muleshe okhwinjila mukhuteemwa; omwoyo nomwangu okhwiyama, ne omubili nomutofu.
Khandi natsia, nasaaya, naboola amakhuwa amalala akeenako.
Niyeetsa khandi, nabanyoola nibali mundoolo, shichila tsimoni tsiabwe tsiali nitsisitoohe; nibakorwa elia bamukalusia.
Niyeetsa olwakhataru, nabasunjila mbu Kho mushikona bukona nimuhuluukha noho? Shikahelile? Eshise bulaano shiakhoola, lole, Omwana wOmundu akhobilwe mumakhono kaboonooni.
Buushe, khutsie; lole, ou'khoba ali ahambi.
Yesu yakhobwa, nahamhwa
Habwenaho, olwa yali nashisunga, Yuda niyeetsa, mulala khwIkhumi-nababili abo, nali nende omukanda kwabetsinganga nende tsindabushi, abarula khubakhulundu babakuhani nende abahandiichi nende abakofu.
Ne omwenoyo owamukhoba yali nabamanyiye eshilolelo, nasunga ari Owa nenzunzuune, neniye; mumuhambe, mumuyile bulayi.
Nolwa yali niyoolileyo, habwenaho niyeetsa ewa Yesu yali, nasunga mbu Rabi; namutsunzuuna muno.
Mana nibamukwakhwo, nibamutiila.
Ne oundi khubasinjilaho yatsomola olukangalwe, nakhupa omusumba womukuhani omukhulundu, namurema eshirwi.
Yesu naye nakalusia, nabasunjila mbu Murulile nende tsinganga netsindabushi okhundiila, shinga abeetsela omunuuli?
Ndabeelenje nineenywe halala muhekalu khatsotselo ninzechesinjia, nimurambamba ta; ne lekha akamahandiiko koosibwe.
Bosi nibamulekha nibeelukha. Omusooliili ozaeelukha
Ne omusooliili undi yamulondakhwo, niyaabaale ingubo yeikitani khumubilikwe omukhaya; nibamuhamba;
ne yalekha ingubo yeikitani eyo, niyeelukha eshihechenye.
Okhuyaasibwa khwaYesu
Nibamuyila Yesu ewomukuhani omukhulundu; nibakhung'aanayo halala ninaye abakhulundu babakuhani bosi, nabakofu nende abahandiichi.
Naye Petero yali ehalekhwo namulondangakhwo, okhuula mulwanyi Iwomukuhani omukhulundu mukari; yali niyeekhaale halala nende abakhalabani, niyoora omulilo.
Abakhulundu babakuhani nende abeshiina bosi nibakhaaba obuloli khuYesu mbu bamwire; ne shibabunyoola ta.
Okhuba abanji barumbula obuloli bwobubeeyi khuye, nebutswa oburumbusi bwabwe shibwafuchilisania ta.
Abandi nibasinjila nibarumbula obuloli bwobubeeyi khuye, bari
Khwamuhulila nasunga mbu Ndalalikulula ihekalu yino eyoombakhwa namakhono, mana mundaalo tsitaru ndaloombakha eyindi eyiroombakhwa namakhono ta.
Ne kata kario oburumbusi bwabwe shibwafuchilisania ta.
Mana omukuhani omukhulundu nasinjila hakari wabwe nareeha Yesu ari Shiokalusia likhuwa ta? Namakhuwa shiina aka bano barumbulanga khwiwe?
Naye naholeela butswa, narakalusia likhuwa liosi ta. Omukuhani omukhulundu namureeba olwakhabili, namusunjila mbu Niwe Kristo owatsana, Omwana woyo owitsoomibwa?
Yesu naboola mbu Isie nisie; khandi mulalola Omwana wOmundu niyeekhaale khumukhono omusaatsa kwObunyali obwo, niyeetsanga mumaleesi akomwikulu.
Haho omukuhani omukhulundu narandula inguboye, naboola mbu Khushikhaaba abaloli mbushi?
Inywe muhuliile obwichelasi bwene; muluutsi murie? Bosi nibamukhalachila eshiina mbu akwanile okhufwa.
Mana abandi nibachaaka okhumunyilikhakhwo amare, nibamufwimba mumoni, nibamuupa ebifuusi, nibamusunjila mbu Lakula; abakhalabani nabo nibamupaama tsikhofi.
Petero yamwambakhana Yesu
Ne olwa Petero yali nali emwalo, mulwanyi, oundi owokhubakhaana abakholi bomukuhani omukhulundu niyeetsa;
nolwa yalola Petero niyooranga omulilo, yamuhenga, nasunga mbu Wesi wabeele nende omuNazareti oyo, Yesu.
Naye niyeeyambakhana, ari Shimanyile aka osunga ta, kata shimbulilanga ta; narula natsia hashilibwa; mana itaywa niyilakula.
Omukhaana oyo namulola, nachaaka khandi okhubasunjila abali nibasinjiileho, ari Uno nimulala khubo.
Naye niyeeyambakhana khandi. Nolunyumakhwo khandi abo abali nibasinjiileho nibasunjila Petero bari Toto mwene shiochweya okhuba mulala khubo ta; shichila oli omuGalilaya.
Naye nachaaka okhwifuuha niyeetsubs, ari Shimumanyile omundu uno owa muboolangakhwo tawe.

Habwenaho itaywa niyilakula olwakhabili. Mana Petero niyeetsulila likhuwa, shinga Yesu olwa yali namusunjiile, mbu Itaywa niyirashialakula khabili ta, naundiyambakhane okhuula khataru. Narundukha mukhulila.
